szoveg_eredeti:
Clover Health is coming to ElevenLabs Summit NYC.

Clover runs voice agents as the front door for member engagement, from care check-ins to helping navigate plan benefits. On November 11, Clover’s Head of Strategy for the Office of the Chairman, Cameron Pringle , sits down with our CRO Ashley Kramer to talk about bringing voice AI into healthcare.

Apply to join: https://lnkd.in/g8y5fqWw
